title: Numbers spoken from television sets

tellings.quote: from being drowned. And Keiel reports on cases where people heard numbers being spoken at them from out of television sets

plain: In the 1960s in the United States, some people said they heard numbers being spoken straight at them out of their television sets. The philosopher Jason Jorjani brings this up on the show without naming a source, and says these cases were reported by the writer John Keel, who collected strange encounters from that period. Told this way, it suggests something odd was trying to reach people through their own household devices.
